chapter.title: Russian Roulette
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (30 nodes), the detroitbecometext template and string table, PowerPyx’s text and the Fandom wiki. EMERGE IN THE ZEN GARDEN → JOIN AMANDA (her reaction to The Nest and Partners, PROMPTS 1, 2, 3 and 5) → ARRIVE AT HANK’S PLACE → [ FIND LT. ANDERSON ] → SPOT HANK AND BREAK IN → ENTER HOUSE → HANK’S DOG ATTACKS → CALM or RILE HANK’S DOG (by knowsSumo) → ANALYZE HANK → TAKE HANK TO THE BATHROOM → DISTANT or UNDERSTANDING ATTITUDE (PROMPT 7), TEASE / LEAVE (PROMPT 8) → three shirts → [ WAIT FOR HANK ] (magazines, TV, the photo of Cole, interests, Sumo, the gun and PROMPT 9) → HANK IS READY → LEFT FOR EDEN CLUB, the only ending. Arrows: Amanda +2 (Rupert caught), −2 (Rupert and the Partners deviant both missed), −1 (Connor died in The Nest), +1 PRAGMATIC, −1 for the self-destruct, −1 HESITATED; Hank −1 on waking only if Connor died in The Nest. No probability, instability or public-opinion change. Researched in docs/research/ch18-russian-roulette.md.

decisions.title: Emerge in the Zen Garden (checkpoint) and Join Amanda
decisions.context: Amanda debriefs Connor on The Nest in the rain. Her opening line and arrow depend on how The Nest ended and on whether the Partners deviant was found.

options.label: Rupert caught (Rupert Committed Suicide)
options.effect: Amanda large up: “Congratulations, Connor, you managed to find that deviant.”

options.label: Rupert not caught, Partners deviant not found
options.effect: Amanda large down: “Two investigations, two failures…”

options.label: Rupert not caught, Partners deviant found
options.effect: No arrow: “A pity you didn’t manage to capture it…”

options.label: Connor died in The Nest
options.effect: Amanda small down: “The last Connor was unfortunately destroyed.”

decisions.note: Chart nodes EMERGE IN THE ZEN GARDEN (checkpoint) and JOIN AMANDA. The wiki’s extra small down for losing Rupert is not in the template and is not built.

benchmark.note: An event; the chapter module reads The Nest (ch15Outcome and companions, else the pre-rebuild C10) and Partners (suspect) and applies Amanda’s arrow.

decisions.title: PRAGMATIC / EXPLAIN / NO EXCUSE
decisions.context: Only when Rupert got away or was never found and Connor survived. Amanda asks, in effect, for an explanation.

options.label: PRAGMATIC
options.effect: Amanda small up: “Maybe you should consider replacing me.”

decisions.gate: Rupert not caught in The Nest, Connor alive.
decisions.note: Template PROMPT 1. The cut TRUTH / LIE follow-up is not built.

benchmark.note: Decision with the game’s three buttons.

decisions.title: What did you learn? (two answers)
decisions.context: Amanda asks what Connor learned, then “What else?”.

options.label: DIARY
options.effect: Needs FIND DIARY in The Nest. No arrow.

options.label: SIGNS ON WALLS
options.effect: Needs SEE RA9 REFERENCE in The Nest. No arrow.

decisions.note: Template PROMPT 2. DEVIANT (Rupert’s forged ID) is bugged in the shipped game and not built. After the answers, the caught branch goes to RR04 (self-destruct), then RR05; other branches go straight to RR05.

benchmark.note: Two rounds; the second drops the first answer and is skipped when nothing is left.

decisions.title: It’s a pity you let it self-destruct
decisions.context: Only when Rupert was caught and jumped. Amanda’s line costs a small down; then Connor answers.
decisions.gate: Rupert Committed Suicide in The Nest.

benchmark.note: Decision; the line’s small down applies on every answer.

decisions.title: How is your relationship with the Lieutenant developing?
decisions.context: Amanda asks about Hank, then closes: “A new case just came in. Find Anderson and investigate it.”

options.label: SAVING HANK
options.effect: Needs SAVE HANK in The Nest. No arrow.

options.label: CONNOR’S DEATH
options.effect: Needs an earlier Connor death. No arrow.

decisions.note: Template PROMPT 5. The cut AX400 conversation is not built.

benchmark.note: Decision; Amanda’s closing lines follow every answer.

decisions.title: Arrive at Hank’s Place (checkpoint) and Find Lt. Anderson
decisions.context: A taxi drops Connor at Hank’s house. Seven optional checks (ring, ring again, knock, car, three windows), or straight to the kitchen window.

options.label: Optional checks
options.effect: No effect; RING AGAIN needs RING BELL.

options.label: Spot Hank and Break In
options.effect: Through the kitchen window: Hank on the floor. Connor breaks in.

decisions.note: Chart: ARRIVE AT HANK’S PLACE, the FIND LT. ANDERSON bracket, SPOT HANK AND BREAK IN.

benchmark.note: An event, then a repeatable scene that ends at the kitchen window.

decisions.title: Enter House (checkpoint): Hank’s dog attacks
decisions.context: Sumo charges at Connor. Not a choice: Connor calms him by name if he learned it in Waiting for Hank…, otherwise riles him.
decisions.note: Template condition on “Connor knows Sumo’s name”. No arrow.

benchmark.note: An event; the branch is read from knowsSumo and recorded in ch18Dog.

decisions.title: Analyze Hank and Take Hank to the Bathroom
decisions.context: Four optional scans (mouth, chest, whisky bottle, revolver: “.357 Magnum, 1 bullet remaining”), then Connor wakes Hank and puts him under the shower.

options.label: Wake him
options.effect: Hank small down only if Connor died in The Nest (“Connor’s dead! I know he’s dead!..”).

decisions.note: PowerPyx’s unconditional Hank▼ is contradicted by the template and the wiki and is not built.

benchmark.note: A repeatable scan scene, then an event.

decisions.title: Distant Attitude or Understanding Attitude
decisions.context: Hank, in the shower: “Can’t you just leave me alone?”
decisions.note: Template PROMPT 7; the wiki maps RATIONAL to Understanding.

decisions.title: Beat it: TEASE or LEAVE
decisions.context: Hank tells Connor to get out; Connor mentions the case. Either way Hank asks for clothes.

decisions.title: Take a shirt for Hank
decisions.note: Chart choice trio; no template prompt and no known later effect.

decisions.title: Read “Pull the Plug?” and “Tainted Love”; watch TV
decisions.context: Two Century magazines on the bedroom floor and the CTN news (President Warren’s warning to Russia over the Arctic).
decisions.gate: Every path, during Wait for Hank.

benchmark.note: Media scene at the start of the wait.

decisions.title: Wait for Hank: Find Picture of Hank’s Son and the house
decisions.context: While Hank dresses, Connor can look at the photo of Cole on the kitchen table (cross-chapter impact), Hank’s record and the picture above the fireplace, pet Sumo, listen at the bathroom door, apologise for the window, pick up the chair, or look at the gun, which ends the wait (PowerPyx).

options.label: Find Picture of Hank’s Son
options.effect: Learn Cole’s name and dates (knowsCole) for The Bridge, Night of the Soul and the tower.

options.label: Learn Hank’s Interests / Pet Hank’s Dog / other looks
Look at the gun
options.effect: Ends the wait; the gun question follows.

decisions.note: The wiki says the photo, not the gun, triggers Hank is Ready; PowerPyx (higher in the source order) says the gun. The photo can be missed.

benchmark.note: A repeatable scene; looking at the gun or waiting ends it.

decisions.title: Learn Hank was Playing Russian Roulette
decisions.context: Connor holds Hank’s revolver: QUESTION (“What were you doing with the gun?” “Russian roulette!”) or SAY NOTHING.

options.label: QUESTION
options.effect: Learn he was playing Russian roulette (ch18Roulette). No arrow.

decisions.gate: Connor looked at the gun during the wait.
decisions.note: Template PROMPT 9; SAY NOTHING from the string table.

decisions.title: Hank is Ready: Left for Eden Club
decisions.context: “Be a good dog, Sumo. I won’t be long.” The chapter’s only ending.

options.label: Left for Eden Club
options.effect: Chapter ends; The Eden Club follows for Connor.

benchmark.note: An event; ch18Outcome records the ending.
